text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Conviction is... right here. 
If I strongly... believe—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
She is... my best answer. 
I will execute... my mission—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The morning after the shocking "Impending 
Guerilla Stream Incident"... 
The atmosphere around the academy was 
slowly beginning to shift.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"That was amazing! It really felt like a 
dance only those two could pull off! 
Don't you want to check out the Droite 
after all?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Man, they really are incredible. Everyone 
everywhere is talking about them. 
Heh... It's because Tan-senpai is totally 
unhinged that she's so cool."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I wanna break through like that, too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(I received your spirit loud and clear, 
Senpai. 
I'm gonna do it too...! Sticking true to 
what I think is 'cool'...!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! I can do this on my own! I'm the 
coolest there is! 
So I'll just blow everyone away somehow... 
somehow... huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, it's called 'Best Date', isn't 
it?!\nWhat the heck am I supposed to do 
now, then?!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"—Behold, the earth has been cleansed by 
the atonement of the two-headed 
demigods.\nThe tyranny of the dust-slaying 
mop shall now reach its end...!"

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, if you're done, quiet 
down! Honestly, after causing such a 
commotion,\nyou have no idea how hard it 
was to get them to settle for just 
cleaning duty!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you! Sorry for the trouble!\nStill, 
that means we're officially scot-free, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it's the Tap-Gimlet senpai 
duo~!\nWe'll come watch the Droite! Good 
luck~♪"

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Fufufu, I was surprised, 
but\napplications have been pouring in 
ever since. Thank you, thank you♪"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Still, did the two of them really pull 
that off all on their own?\nThe stage, the 
live stream... on such a massive 
scale...?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Who knows? We don't know a single thing."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"We just went to the rooftop to do an 
UmaSta Live...\nand there just happened to 
be the perfect stage right there!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Kuku...! And that strange malfunction 
with the campus broadcast...\nA truly 
baffling mystery indeed..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously!\nWho would've thought all that 
stuff would just be sitting there... 
Hahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Well then... once we clean up, let's 
hurry to the dance studio.\nSee ya, 
everyone! Look forward to the Droite!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa...! Symboli Kris S is apparently 
pairing up with Cesario!\nThat's so hype! 
We've gotta step up our game too!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Good work. That was a magnificent 
dance.\nIt has gotten quite crowded here 
since then, hasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "Thank you...\n—You seem pleased."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Yes, very much so."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"When we have more pairs like you who can 
deliver first-rate performances,\nit 
elevates the prestige of the entire 
party."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I believe building upon things like 
this\nalso directly influences the dignity 
of the racing world..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed—the stature of the academy—is the 
stature of the racing world.\nOkay—I will 
hype things up."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you.\nI shall hold you in high 
expectation."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"The key players are gathering...\nThe 
wind is blowing in a good direction."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Hhhnnngggghhh......\nAh... 
Journey-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Perfect timing...!\nUmm, could I ask you 
for some advice?!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I see... You've come to terms with it. 
Made up your mind.\nAnd having done that, 
you are wondering 'Who should I pair up 
with...?'"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I totally gave up on being Gim-senpai's 
date.\nEven without senpai pulling me 
along, I can still be plenty cool!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"But then, when it comes to who else to 
ask, nobody really clicks.\n...Either way, 
I really wanna win Best Date!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I see...\nYou've decided not to be her 
'date'—but her 'rival' instead."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... was I mistaken?\nI thought it was a 
splendid spirit to have."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Standing in her way as a rival...\nI 
imagine Gimlet-san would be delighted as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Me... Gim-senpai's rival.\nOh... so 
that's how it is...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, I didn't even realize until you 
said it!\nThat... sounds super cool!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, yes.\nI think it is very cool 
indeed."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"All that is left is to find someone 
compatible to partner with...\nThere is no 
need to hesitate."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "I see..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...In that case, someone comes to 
mind!\nAn awesome Umamusume who's not just 
skilled, but has an ironclad spirit too!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"My, my... Then you had best go ask them 
quickly.\nBefore someone else beats you to 
it."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Yes! I'll do that!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Journey-senpai!\nPlease be my date!"
